name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Ground Breakers
archetype: Electric-immune Fire/Ground starter sweeper, dual Ground physical breakers, and Intimidate aerial pivots.
gym_duel_rationale: Lt. Surge enforces a strict 3v3 duel. Enter the arena with Charmeleon/Dugtrio (106 Base Speed, 100% Electric immunity, STAB Flame Burst and Magnitude, plus fixed 40 damage Dragon Rage), Primeape/Sandslash (445 BST, Vital Spirit sleep immunity, and STAB Cross Chop + Magnitude), and Kadabra/Geodude (100% Electric immunity special artillery with Psybeam and Reflect).

roster.progression_notes: Permanent starter anchor spliced with Diglett/Dugtrio from Diglett's Cave. 106 Base Speed Fire/Ground sweeper that completely ignores Electric attacks while hitting back with super-effective Magnitude.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 3 & Mt. Moon Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Combines Primeape's raw physical power with Sandslash's defensive bulk. Vital Spirit prevents sleep moves, while STAB Magnitude and Cross Chop punch through steel and rock.

roster.status: Active in Party (Route 24 & Mt. Moon Splice)
roster.progression_notes: Splicing freed Kadabra with Geodude yields a 90 SpA special attacker with 100% Electric immunity that sets Reflect screens against physical retaliation.
Retained from Chapter 2. Compound Eyes ensures 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder, while Grass/Flying typing quad-resists Grass and resists Water.
495 BST powerhouse with 101 Attack and 93 Speed. Intimidate cripples enemy physical sweepers, while Drill Run and Aerial Ace provide superb open-route coverage.

flex_bench.why_use: Excellent defensive typing with Magic Guard immunity to indirect passive damage.
Gathers bonus consumable items after battle and earns extra prize money via Pay Day.

active_fusions: Charmeleon/Dugtrio (106 Speed Fire/Ground starter anchor with 100% Electric immunity)
Primeape/Sandslash (103 Attack Fighting/Ground juggernaut with Vital Spirit)
Bellsprout/Butterfree (Compound Eyes 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder support)
Gyarados/Fearow (495 BST Intimidate physical sweeper with Drill Run)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Visit the Vermilion City Poké Mart and pay $300 to unfuse Charmeleon/Kadabra from Chapter 2, separating Charmeleon and Kadabra.
2. Catch a high-speed Diglett in Diglett's Cave and splice with Charmeleon to create Charmeleon/Dugtrio, completely immunizing your starter against Surge's Electric blitz.
3. Splice the freed Kadabra with Geodude to form Kadabra/Geodude for Ground/Psychic duel coverage.
upcoming_fusions: Charizard/Kadabra (Re-splice Charizard with Kadabra at Lv. 36 for an apex 112 SpA Fire/Psychic sweeper)
Jolteon/Houndour (Fast Fire/Electric special glass cannon via Celadon evolution stones)
